    # Normalize the input path to absolute
    if not path.startswith('/'):
        path = cwd.rstrip('/') + '/' + path
    
    # Split into components and filter out empty and '.' components
    components = [c for c in path.split('/') if c and c != '.']
    
    current = '/'
    link_count = 0
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(components):
        component = components[i]
        
        if component == '..':
            # Move to parent, but don't go above root
            if current != '/':
                current = '/'.join(current.split('/')[:-1])
                if not current:
                    current = '/'
        else:
            # Append component to current path
            if current == '/':
                current = '/' + component
            else:
                current = current + '/' + component
            
            # Check if current path is a symlink
            if current in links:
                link_count += 1
                if link_count > 8:
                    return None
                
                target = links[current]
                
                # Get remaining components after this one
                remaining = components[i + 1:]
                
                # Process the symlink target
                if target.startswith('/'):
                    # Absolute symlink target
                    current = '/'
                    target_components = [c for c in target.split('/') if c and c != '.']
                else:
                    # Relative symlink target - relative to parent of the link
                    parent = '/'.join(current.split('/')[:-1])
                    if not parent:
                        parent = '/'
                    current = parent
                    target_components = [c for c in target.split('/') if c and c != '.']
                
                # Replace components with target components + remaining
                components = target_components + remaining
                i = 0
                continue
        
        i += 1
    
    # Ensure no trailing slash except for root
    if current != '/' and current.endswith('/'):
        current = current.rstrip('/')
    
    return current
